notes.title: KAUNA development update #1
notes.content:
Hello! 

Development of KAUNA is progressing well, and I’d like to share some highlights from the past few months.

This is the first devlog‑type post, and I hope it gives you insight into how KAUNA evolves.

A big thanks to everyone who has wishlisted the game—your support means the world to me!



That said, here are some of the features I want to share:


Car


The game will feature a fully drivable car and driving levels where you can run over hordes of enemies. You get a short ride at the beginning of the game. Later, the car is stolen by demons, and your mission is to retrieve it while fighting your way through the Underworld.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544748/0a179872bde8f9e5cd3c60b2ae5733c43ff72755.png"]
Keybindings menu


I spent a lot of time getting the key‑bindings menu to work, and it was definitely worth it. It makes the game much more accessible.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544748/b978c63cf75748d9f8559bf45a9d6a317cba33f1.png"]
Custom skyboxes and more detailed levels


I've added several new custom skyboxes and increased level detail to give the world a more polished feel.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544748/f95077f2137ae4ce6749ad73b3c2e77a1ae49d56.png"]
New enemy: Tuonela Acolyte


A new melee enemy that also has ranged‑spell‑casting and archer variants. These zombie‑like cultists appear later in the game.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544748/eba1e84ea79333d7b538d197b252be2c9f37782e.png"]
What next?


My next big milestone is to release a demo on Steam. That will involve polishing mechanics and levels, as well as completing several unfinished areas over the coming months. 



A new trailer is also in progress, so you can expect it to drop sometime soon!



-Antti
